title: Lemon Bars
description: Aunt Ruth brought these to every summer picnic.
directions: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Beat the butter and powdered sugar until fluffy, then mix in the flour. Press into the pan and bake for 20 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, flour, lemon juice and zest until smooth. Pour over the hot crust.
Bake for 25 minutes more, until the filling is set. Cool completely before cutting.
notes: Tip: Dust with powdered sugar just before serving.

title: Brown Butter Shortbread
directions: Brown the butter in a saucepan, then chill until firm.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and salt, then stir in the flour.
Roll into a log, chill for 1 hour, slice and bake at 325°F for 15 minutes.

title: Roasted Tomato Soup
description: Grandpa Joe's favorite on a cold night.
directions: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the olive oil on a sheet pan.
Roast for 40 minutes, until soft and browned at the edges.
Blend with the broth until smooth, then warm in a pot with the cream.
